name: Igarashi Kasumi
source:
Born to prideful upper-class parents who renounced her due to her betraying their expectations, she received no affection, but only large sums of spending money.

Because of this, she hasn't made any friends and doesn't care about her appearance, instead living in the world of video games.

Still, without the meddling of her parents and free to do as she pleases, she has no complaints about her life at present.
